title: CoordsBroadcast
description: Why not make lifesteal a bit more fun and challenging?
body:
🧭 CoordsBroadcast – Make Lifesteal a Bit More... Dangerous 👀
Tired of hiding like a coward after every kill?
Want to spice up your Lifesteal SMP with some real consequences?

Introducing CoordsBroadcast, a Minecraft plugin that automatically broadcasts a player’s coordinates the moment they get a kill. No more silent assassins — now, every successful hit turns the killer into the hunted.

Perfect for Lifesteal SMP servers, this plugin:

📡 Reveals the killer’s location to everyone — balance power with paranoia.

🔥 Turns PvP into high-stakes gameplay — no more easy escapes.

💀 Adds risk to every kill, encouraging smarter strategies and alliances.

“You can steal a heart… but at what cost?”

Make your server more thrilling, social, and chaotic — exactly how a Lifesteal world should be.
